title: HttpClientContribution
description: A code-declared outbound HTTP client binding to a remote API: Spring `@FeignClient` / `WebClient` / `RestClient`, OpenFeign, Retrofit, Axios instance, Python `httpx.Client`, Go `http.Client` wrapper, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` (Feign/RestClient today); future framework-specific KSs.

clientSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the client interface / class / instance. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

baseUrl.description: Static base URL when declarable (literal, configuration-key reference, or service-discovery name).

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). E.g. Feign `configuration` class, Retrofit converters, Axios interceptors, mTLS / OAuth scopes.
